content: this is a summary of a civil case that took place in the alytaus district court the case involved a matrimonial property dispute between two parties referred to as ds and rs they have been married for 32 years but have been living separately for the past 12 years the court has decided to dissolve their marriage and divide their property and obligations according to an agreement reached by the parties the specific details of the case including the cost and duration are not mentioned the movable property involved includes several cars and there is also immovable property and debt related to the state tax inspectorate the court has approved the agreement and addressed the issue of a credit card debt determining it to be a joint obligation of the spouses the court has considered the evidence provided and made a decision to dissolve the marriage and divide the property accordingly the court has also confirmed the legal consequences of the divorce agreement which covers various aspects such as the division of property and obligations and the maintenance of surnames the agreement was entered into freely and consensually by the parties and is in accordance with the laws of lithuania it will come into force upon the courts decision to dissolve the marriage and any substantial changes in circumstances can be addressed through a court modification of the agreement
